caption: The drawing features a bonnet-like headpiece displayed prominently in the top half of the composition, rendered in tan and beige colors with intricate white floral patterns embroidered across its surface. The fabric appears textured, and the edges are bordered by a lighter, plain band. Below the bonnet, there is a pencil sketch of a woman's head in profile, facing left, wearing the same headpiece; the sketch shows stylized hair and an earring, but is executed with faint, simple lines and minimal detail. The artist's name, Gladys C. Parker, is written in small, clear text to the right of the head sketch. The overall background is off-white, and no additional objects are present.
title: Lace Cap
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
